reviews.scope: Reference-value ledger for Chutes TEE (Intel TDX) inference. Each row's `signoff` is either `analyst-pair` (a human reviewer promoted it; audited_by lists them) or `agent-draft-baseline` (an agent-draft review awaiting promotion). This ledger is WEAKER than near-ai's cloud-api ledger by construction of its audit unit: mrtd measures only the dstack base TD, NOT serve.py on the prompt-plaintext path (CFSV-excluded, in no RTMR — see verifiers/chutes.py), and the model sits in no measured register (MRTD/RTMRs identical across all -TEE models). So a matching mrtd attests the base image only; it does NOT prove the serving code wasn't modified to read/exfiltrate the decrypted prompt or substitute the model. Reference value = mrtd; source-of-truth for serving code = chutes-api (unmeasured). Anchor = provider golden set (self-attested, not on-chain). verifiers/chutes.py sets details.mrtd_audited from membership here; diffalert uses it only to silence the known fleet flip-flop, not as a trust claim. Refresh: mrtd is instance-sampled, so the fleet flip-flops between coexisting values rather than deploying serially; a value not in this ledger raises unaudited-mrtd:chutes/<model> for review.

This ledger is WEAKER than near-ai's cloud-api ledger by construction of its audit unit: mrtd measures only the dstack base TD, NOT serve.py on the prompt-plaintext path (CFSV-excluded, in no RTMR — see verifiers/chutes.py), and the model sits in no measured register (MRTD/RTMRs identical across all -TEE models). So a matching mrtd attests the base image only; it does NOT prove the serving code wasn't modified to read/exfiltrate the decrypted prompt or substitute the model. Reference value = mrtd; source-of-truth for serving code = chutes-api (unmeasured). Anchor = provider golden set (self-attested, not on-chain). verifiers/chutes.py sets details.mrtd_audited from membership here; diffalert uses it only to silence the known fleet flip-flop, not as a trust claim. Refresh: mrtd is instance-sampled, so the fleet flip-flops between coexisting values rather than deploying serially; a value not in this ledger raises unaudited-mrtd:chutes/<model> for review.

Reference-value ledger for the Tinfoil confidential-inference gateway ('router') enclave, repo tinfoilsh/confidential-model-router. Each row's `signoff` is either `analyst-pair` (a human reviewer promoted it; audited_by lists them) or `agent-draft-baseline` (an agent-draft review awaiting promotion). Each entry is one sigstore-attested router release tag — identified by its ATC bundle digest (the sha256 in that tag's tinfoil.hash) and full SEV-SNP snp_measurement — confirmed to carry a sound re-attesting routing posture (verifies each backend model enclave against a repo pin baked into the router's own attested config.yml; see notes). Identity is the bundle digest, not the image digest — Tinfoil binds the measurement to a TAGGED GitHub release build via sigstore/GitHub-OIDC (SAN pinned to .../@refs/tags/<tag>), which is what verifiers/tinfoil.py re-verifies. verifiers/tinfoil.py sets details.digest_audited from membership here (None when no ledger exists for a model's repo); a dashboard cell consuming it is NOT wired yet (tasks/todo.md Phase 4). Refresh: when a live probe surfaces a new router bundle_digest (i.e. a new release tag), diffalert raises version:tinfoil/router; capture it, diff the source vs the last audited tag, and append a row. A tag bump touching only build/deps (Dockerfile, go.mod, config placeholder) is MUNDANE and admissible on continuity grounds; changes under manager/ (addEnclave, updateModelMeasurements), config.yml repo pins, or the shim path allowlist are SUBSTANTIVE and require a fresh read.
